name: diag_scratch_authorized_inventory_01
command:
import os,json,stat,hashlib,datetime
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/scratch/e1583364/cvpr2027')
cache_roots=[base/'cache'/name for name in ('pip','torch_extensions','triton','pycache')]
weights=[]
for run,job in [('smoke_e2e_T0_02','707612.hopper-m-02'),('smoke_e2e_T3_01','707642.hopper-m-02')]:
 root=base/'smoke_e2e'/run/job/'checkpoint'
 weights += [root/side/(kind+'_world_size_1_rank_0.pt') for side,kind in [('actor','optim'),('actor','extra_state'),('critic','model'),('critic','optim'),('critic','extra_state')]]
groups=[]; files=[]
def entry(path,category):
 st=path.lstat()
 assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_uid==os.getuid(),str(path)
 return {'path':str(path),'category':category,'bytes':st.st_size,'allocated_bytes':st.st_blocks*512,'device':st.st_dev,'inode':st.st_ino,'mtime_ns':st.st_mtime_ns,'uid':st.st_uid}
for directory in cache_roots:
 assert directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink()
 selected=[]
 for parent,dirs,names in os.walk(directory,followlinks=False):
  assert all(not (Path(parent)/name).is_symlink() for name in dirs)
  selected += [entry(Path(parent)/name,'A') for name in names]
 files.extend(selected)
 groups.append({'path':str(directory),'category':'A','files':len(selected),'bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in selected),'allocated_bytes':sum(r['allocated_bytes'] for r in selected)})
for path in weights:
 row=entry(path,'B');files.append(row)
 groups.append({'path':str(path),'category':'B','files':1,'bytes':row['bytes'],'allocated_bytes':row['allocated_bytes']})
# Exact existing filenames named by any result/audit are ineligible. Keep all
# directory descriptors, original results/logs, and last actor model intact.
protected=[]
candidate_paths={r['path'] for r in files}
audit_paths=list(Path('logs').glob('*audit*.json'))+list(Path('logs/reports').glob('*audit*.json'))
for source in [*Path('results').glob('*.json'),*audit_paths]:
 text=source.read_text(errors='replace')
 if not any(str(root) in text for root in [*cache_roots,*(p.parent for p in weights)]): continue
 for path in candidate_paths:
  if path in text: protected.append({'candidate':path,'source':str(source)})
assert not protected,'Referenced candidates: '+repr(protected)
assert len({r['path'] for r in files})==len(files)
out=Path('logs/review/diag_scratch_authorized_inventory_01');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
manifest={'authority':'43bc49c5 AGENTS scratch storage and explicit human instruction','created_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'groups':groups,'files':files,'protected_matches':protected,'last_actor_models_preserved':True,'deletion_performed':False}
target=out/'manifest.json';target.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
status=Path('STATUS.md')
lines=['\n### 2026-11-09 scratch授权清理：删除前清单（43bc49c5）\n','只清理下表A缓存和B旧冒烟optimizer/critic/extra-state文件；保留最后actor模型、其配置、所有结果/日志、世界对/视角表、基础HF模型和环境。逐文件所有者、路径、inode、size/mtime清单及结果/审计引用排除检查见 '+str(target)+'。尚未执行删除。\n','|类别|路径|文件数|文件字节|分配字节|','|---|---|---:|---:|---:|']
for row in groups:lines.append('|{category}|{path}|{files}|{bytes}|{allocated_bytes}|'.format(**row))
status.write_text(status.read_text()+'\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'manifest':str(target),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'groups':groups,'deletion_performed':False},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
